name: ClickShare
product: Barco ClickShare Desktop App

evidence.says: Barco lists the ClickShare Desktop App Mac DMG version 4.52.0.11, released November 9, 2026.
Barco identifies the currently available desktop app as x86_64 and says it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon while a native release is in development.

notes: Barco documents the desktop app and the separate ClickShare Button launcher individually.

name: Nik Collection Install
product: DxO Nik Collection macOS installer

evidence.says: DxO's guide shows the installation application selecting a destination and host applications before installing the Nik Collection tools.

notes: The scanned bundle ID identifies the installer, while the collection's individual photo tools have their own executables.

name: ABBYY FineReader for ScanSnap
product: ABBYY FineReader for ScanSnap for Mac, bundled OCR from ABBYY and PFU/Ricoh

evidence.says: ABBYY labels FineReader for ScanSnap discontinued and says the 5.5 Mac release is compatible with Apple M1.
PFU/Ricoh confirms that ABBYY FineReader for ScanSnap is no longer supported.

limitation: The vendor confirms M1 compatibility without specifying the final build's executable architecture.
notes: This is the scanner-bundled edition.

name: NoxInstaller
product: NoxPlayer macOS installer by BigNox

evidence.says: BigNox distributes the NoxPlayer Android emulator and has a separate Mac download link.
BigNox's download instructions distinguish the installer download from the NoxPlayer application it installs.

notes: The scanned NoxAppPlayerInstaller.app and com.nox.NoxInstaller identify the installer.

name: Airtame
product: Airtame desktop presentation and screen-sharing app by Airtame

evidence.says: Airtame dates desktop app 4.16.1 to October 29, 2026 and records a macOS 27 audio streaming fix.
Airtame states that the current macOS app is Intel-based and works on Apple Silicon through Rosetta 2, with a native app planned.

notes: Airtame announced a staged rollout for a separately built native app; the vendor's current downloadable release is covered here.

name: JupyterLab
product: JupyterLab Desktop by Project Jupyter

evidence.says: The project published JupyterLab Desktop 4.6.3-1 on August 26, 2026.
The release includes both a macOS arm64 installer and a macOS arm64 ZIP.
GitHub's release metadata marks the later 4.6.4-1 tag as a prerelease and lists no binary assets.

notes: This is the Electron desktop distribution of JupyterLab.

name: VCV Rack 2 Free
product: VCV Rack 2 Free by VCV

evidence.says: VCV lists 2.6.6 for Rack 2 Free and identifies Apple ARM64 as a supported architecture.
VCV lists the Rack Free 2.6.6 macOS x64+arm64 package dated November 4, 2025.

name: Fortin Cali Suite
product: Neural DSP Fortin Cali Suite standalone guitar amp and effects app

evidence.says: Neural DSP lists Fortin Cali Suite 2.0.1, dated May 16, 2023, as the current macOS installer.
The vendor's announcement for this update specifies a universal binary for the Fortin Cali Suite standalone app.

notes: The same installer also offers plug-in formats.

name: Lark
product: Lark Suite's Lark desktop collaboration app

evidence.says: The live Homebrew cask lists Lark 8.7.16 with a vendor-hosted darwin_arm64 DMG, separate darwin_x64 variants and cache paths identifying com.electron.lark.

notes: The evidence is for the international Lark download. Feishu shares the bundle ID in historical scans and has its own distribution channel.

name: MetaMovie
product: MetaMovie by Appfacture

evidence.says: Appfacture's release notes say MetaMovie 2.6.0 is built as a universal Mac app.
Apple's storefront metadata ties version 2.6.0 and its August 5, 2026 release to com.appfacture.mac.MetaMovie.

name: SkySafari 6 Pro
product: SkySafari 6 Pro for macOS by Simulation Curriculum Corp.

evidence.says: Simulation Curriculum's Mac App Store listing identifies 6.8.2 as its latest release, dated April 21, 2021.
A user posted a macOS crash report showing the exact bundle ID and 6.8.2 (6820) running as X86-64 (Translated) on an Apple M1.
A SkySafari 6 Pro user on an M1 Max MacBook Pro reports using the app successfully after a slow launch.

limitation: Intel-only status comes from a versioned user crash report and user descriptions; the publisher does not list the binary slices.
notes: These findings apply to the distinct SkySafari 6 Pro macOS app.

name: G*Power
product: G*Power statistical power analysis by the G*Power team at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf

evidence.says: The G*Power team dates the 3.1.9.7 macOS release to November 23, 2026 and lists support for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

Static inspection of the official ZIP confirmed that G*Power.app/Contents/MacOS/G*Power is a universal Mach-O with arm64 and x86_64 slices and that Info.plist gives version 3.1.9.7 and bundle ID gpower.

notes: The same 3.1.9.7 version number appeared earlier for Windows; the native Mac release is dated November 23, 2026.

name: AirPods Sound Quality Fixer
product: AirPods Sound Quality Fixer and Battery Life Enhancer for macOS by milgra

evidence.says: The maintainer's release page identifies version 1.0 as the initial release and links the precompiled Mac app.
Static inspection of version 1.0's AirPods Sound Quality Fixer.app/Contents/MacOS/AirPods Sound Quality Fixer found a single x86_64 Mach-O slice; Info.plist confirms the version and bundle ID.
A user links the exact milgra application and reports it works under Rosetta.

limitation: Rosetta operation was user-reported, and supported macOS versions were not independently verified.

name: Fine Woodworking Archive
product: Fine Woodworking Archive legacy desktop reader from The Taunton Press and Fine Woodworking

evidence.says: A Fine Woodworking editor confirms the earlier archive had a dedicated Mac application and says the 2019 edition was updated for 64-bit.
A purchaser reproduces the 2024 edition's Intel processor requirement and reports it would not run on Apple Silicon.
The publisher lists a redesigned 2025 archive with browser requirements and directs USB and digital customers to its new archive help.
The publisher's 2025-and-later instructions say to open the archive's Start Here HTML file in a browser.

limitation: The last native-application version number and its Mach-O slices were not established; the 2024 edition's documented requirements specified Intel.
notes: The archive content is still sold in a browser-based format, which replaced the legacy Mac reader.

name: pico8
product: PICO-8 Fantasy Console by Lexaloffle Games

evidence.says: Lexaloffle announced the release of PICO-8 0.2.7 on August 16, 2025.
Lexaloffle documents that the Mac distribution became universal in 0.2.6, with native support for Apple Silicon.
A published macOS crash report identifies the main com.lexaloffle.pico8 executable as version 0.2.7 and ARM-64 Native.

notes: The current version's ARM64 evidence is a user-submitted macOS report on the developer forum.

name: GoogleKeepMenu
product: GoogleKeepMenu by Brecht Machiels, a macOS menu-bar client for Google Keep

evidence.says: Machiels publishes 0.2.0 as the latest release; I inspected GoogleKeepMenu.app.zip and found that the bundle ID matches and Contents/MacOS/GoogleKeepMenu is x86_64 only.

limitation: I found no evidence that this version still signs in to Google Keep or works on Apple Silicon through Rosetta.

name: NCALayer
product: NCALayer by the National Certification Authority of the Republic of Kazakhstan

evidence.says: I inspected the current NCALayer.dmg linked on the official downloads page; NCALayer.app identifies itself as kz.gov.pki.ncalayer bundle version 1.3 and its Contents/MacOS/JavaMacLauncher is x86_64 only.
The official installation guide identifies NCALayer.app as the runnable macOS signing client installed from the DMG.
Doodocs reports that NCALayer launches through Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon Macs.
An M1 user on the certification authority’s forum reports installing and running NCALayer, but the eGov service did not detect it.

limitation: Successful end-to-end signing under Rosetta and the bundle release date remain unverified.
notes: The version is the bundle's CFBundleVersion because the app has no CFBundleShortVersionString.

name: OpenConnect-GUI
product: OpenConnect VPN GUI by the OpenConnect project

evidence.says: The upstream 1.6.2 release assets are source archives and a Windows installer.
MacPorts lists arm64 build artifacts for its port of OpenConnect-GUI 1.6.2.
The former upstream GitHub release page directs users to the project's current website for releases.

limitation: The current arm64 binary is packaged by MacPorts, and I found no corresponding upstream macOS binary for 1.6.2.
notes: The historical upstream Mac build and the current third-party native package are distinct distribution channels.

name: OED
product: Oxford University Press Oxford English Dictionary, second edition on CD-ROM, version 4.0 for Mac

evidence.says: Oxford University Press identifies the OED v4.0 CD-ROM Mac app and lists its PowerPC or Intel-era Mac OS X requirements.
Mendelson documents that the 2009 Mac edition is a 32-bit application and cannot run in macOS Catalina or later.
Apple confirms that macOS Catalina 10.15 and later cannot run 32-bit applications.

limitation: The bundle ID identifies the shared Screenweaver runtime, so identification relies on the matching OED v4.0 application name in the scan and publisher documentation.
notes: The Wine workaround uses the Windows release.

name: DisplayPilot
product: Original BenQ Display Pilot monitor-control utility for macOS

evidence.says: BenQ's specifications for the original Display Pilot give Mac version 1.1.2.5 and document compatible monitors.
BenQ states that original Display Pilot 1.0.9.5 and later work natively on Apple Silicon and that the latest release does not require Rosetta.

notes: The name-matched Homebrew cask now distributes the separately named Display Pilot 2.

name: monday.com
product: monday.com desktop app for macOS by monday.com Ltd.

evidence.says: The vendor identifies the Mac App Store listing as the official download for its desktop app.
Apple's storefront API identifies bundle ID com.monday.desktop and release 1.0.46 dated October 8, 2026.
The Mac-only storefront listing publishes version 1.0.46 and the minimum macOS requirement without specifying processor architecture.

limitation: No architecture statement or inspectable current installer was found for the Mac App Store desktop build.
notes: The separate monday.com mobile app has its own App Store listing.

name: SoftwareForArchers Xpert
product: SoftwareForArchers Xpert (SFAX) desktop by Pinwheel Software

evidence.says: Pinwheel labels the linked OS X archive its current and authorized SFAX desktop download.
Static inspection of the vendor ZIP's SFA2534-3.dmg confirmed its SFA.app/Contents/MacOS/SFA is x86_64 only; Info.plist identifies version 2.5.34 and com.pinwheelsoftware.SFA.

limitation: There was no Rosetta runtime report for the inspected Mac build.
notes: The current vendor download's plist reports 2.5.34 although the historical scan lists 2.8.

name: CamTwist
product: CamTwist Studio virtual camera and live video effects app by Allocinit

evidence.says: CamTwist's vendor page offers version 3.4.3 as the current download.

Static inspection of the official Mac image found x86_64-only Mach-O code in both CamTwist.app/Contents/MacOS/CamTwist and the virtual camera plug-in, with Info.plist confirming version 3.4.3 and the listing's bundle ID.
The author reports getting CamTwist to work on an M2 Mac mini, then reports its legacy virtual camera stopped being recognized after updating to macOS Sonoma 14.1.

limitation: Successful runtime operation comes from a user report; the legacy virtual camera may fail on newer macOS releases.
notes: The app and its camera plug-in are separate components.

name: Metadatics
product: Metadatics audio metadata editor by Mark V Apps

evidence.says: The developer’s update feed dates standalone build 388 of Metadatics 1.8.1 to October 17, 2026, and links its ZIP.
Inspection of Metadatics.app/Contents/MacOS/Metadatics in the official ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices in the bundle identified as com.markvapps.metadatics version 1.8.1.
Apple’s store metadata identifies the same bundle and lists Mac App Store version 1.8.1 released October 19, 2026.

notes: The release date and executable inspection refer to the developer-distributed build.

name: YemuZip
product: YemuZip by Yellow Mug Software

evidence.says: Yellow Mug lists version 2.5 as its direct download and also links an App Store edition.
Inspection of YemuZip.app/Contents/MacOS/YemuZip found only x86_64 in the official DMG whose Info.plist identifies com.yellowmug.YemuZip version 2.5.

limitation: No credible Apple Silicon runtime report was found for the vendor’s 2.5 download.
notes: The App Store still lists the older 2.4.8 release.

name: P4Merge
product: P4 Merge by Perforce Software

evidence.says: Perforce’s 2026.3 Mac client installation documentation lists x86_64 and Arm64 and identifies P4 Merge as an included app.
Perforce’s P4 Merge documentation explicitly records the introduction of universal macOS binaries with native arm64 and Intel support in 2023.2.
Perforce dates the 2026.3 Update 2 suite build 3148619 to November 17, 2026.
Homebrew identifies p4merge.app as an installed application in the official P4V 2026.3 build 3148619 Mac DMG.

limitation: The architecture of the current p4merge executable was established from Perforce’s suite and product documentation without inspecting the DMG.
notes: P4 Merge ships in the P4V installer as a separate app.

name: Mubu Desktop
product: Mubu (幕布) desktop outliner by Shenzhen Shilihu Technology

evidence.says: Mubu’s download page identifies its desktop client and offers an M-series Mac build and a universal Mac option.
Homebrew identifies 幕布.app as com.mubu.desktop and maps its 6.1.1 Apple Silicon build to the vendor’s arm64 DMG with a separate Intel-platform URL.
Mubu’s CDN serves the versioned 6.1.1 arm64 Mac disk image named by the cask.

name: Vuze
product: Vuze BitTorrent Client, formerly Azureus, by Vuze Inc.

evidence.says: Vuze still offers the BitTorrent desktop client from its official site.
Homebrew identifies 5.7.7.0 as the current Mac release and points to Vuze's own installer.
Inspection of the installed-app payload in this DMG identifies com.azureus.vuze version 5.7.7.0 and finds only x86_64 in Vuze.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation of the inspected 5.7.7.0 build was not established.
notes: The executable inspected was the installed app’s main launcher inside the installer payload.

name: GitMind
product: GitMind desktop mind-mapping app by WangxuTech (Apowersoft)

evidence.says: The official GitMind product page offers a Mac desktop download.
Inspection of GitMind.app/Contents/MacOS/GitMind in the official desktop download found x86_64 and arm64 slices in version 1.2.5 with bundle ID com.wangxutech.gitmind.

notes: The current official download for the same GitMind desktop product uses com.wangxutech.gitmind, replacing the scanned com.apowersoft.gitmind identifier.

name: Rember
product: Rember by Kelley Computing, a graphical front end for the memtest memory tester

evidence.says: Kelley Computing links Rember 0.3.7b, and I inspected the linked Rember.dmg to confirm that Rember.app/Contents/MacOS/Rember contains x86_64, i386 and legacy PowerPC slices and that the bundled memtest also has Intel and PowerPC slices only.

limitation: I found no credible test of memory testing through Rosetta on an Apple Silicon Mac.
notes: The Intel x86_64 slice is the only slice relevant to recent macOS. The archive still supplies the download.

name: Scenarist
product: KIT Scenarist screenwriting app by DimkaNovikov Labs

evidence.says: The developer ended support and updates after June 2023 and directed future development to Story Architect.

The official archive dates scenarist-setup-0.7.2.rc15_latest.dmg to February 21, 2022; I inspected it and found that Scenarist.app matches the scanned bundle ID and Contents/MacOS/Scenarist is x86_64 only.

notes: The final official Mac build is not native. The developer still offers an archived download, and Story Architect is a separate successor.

name: HyperDock
product: HyperDock Dock enhancement by bahoom

evidence.says: The official download lists stable HyperDock 1.8, and in its HyperDock.dmg I inspected HyperDock.prefpane/Contents/MacOS/HyperDock and the bundled HyperDock Helper executable, both x86_64 only.
A user reports running HyperDock 1.8 on an M1 Mac with macOS Sequoia and using its icon gestures and window management.
The vendor distinguishes the Mac App Store edition from the direct edition, saying the store edition has a reduced feature set.

limitation: The Rosetta report and inspected binary are for the direct 1.8 distribution, and the older App Store bundle's current availability and compatibility were not verified.
notes: The direct download packages the same product as de.bahoom.HyperDock.prefpane with a de.bahoom.HyperDock-Helper app, while the listing carries the store-era de.bahoom.HyperDock identifier.

name: Crushee
product: Crushee batch image resizing and optimization app by Xander Frangos

evidence.says: The developer marks 2.4.6 as the latest release, and I inspected the official Crushee-v2.4.6-mac.dmg to verify the matching bundle ID and x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/Crushee executable.

limitation: I found no credible evidence of Rosetta operation for the current Mac build.

name: UltraEdit
product: UltraEdit for Mac by UltraEdit, formerly IDM Computer Solutions

evidence.says: I inspected the linked UltraEdit.dmg and found bundle com.idmcomp.uex version 25.0.0.180 with a universal x86_64 and arm64 executable at UltraEdit.app/Contents/MacOS/UltraEdit.
UltraEdit lists the current Mac release under the marketing version 2025.0 and dates this release October 29, 2026.

notes: The binary is bundle version 25.0.0.180, which the vendor markets as UltraEdit 2025.0.

name: WestWorldSS
product: WestWorldSS (西部世界VPN) Mac client by WestWorldSS

evidence.says: WestWorldSS offers its 2.0.4 Mac client and lists support for both Intel and Apple M1 chips.
Inspection of the vendor-linked DMG found x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices in 西部世界VPN.app/Contents/MacOS/WestWorldSS, and the matching bundle identifies itself as com.wwss.WWSS version 2.0.4.

notes: The vendor's current client uses com.wwss.WWSS in place of the older com.wwss.WestWorldSS4 bundle ID.

name: Electron Hellofont
product: HelloFont (字由) desktop font manager by Hanyi Fonts and HelloFont

evidence.says: The official download page maps platform ID 1 to the macOS client.
The vendor release endpoint reports Mac version 5.0.5 with an August 19, 2026 timestamp.
The vendor's official Mac arm64 download endpoint returns a DMG explicitly labeled 5.0.5-arm64.

notes: Use the localized 字由 or HelloFont product name rather than the old Electron-derived display name.

name: reMarkable
product: reMarkable desktop companion app by reMarkable AS

evidence.says: reMarkable describes its Mac desktop companion and points to its supported installation channels.
The Mac App Store lists the developer's current 3.29.0 release without specifying the executable's architecture.
Apple's storefront API ties the October 15, 2026 release of 3.29.0 to the exact com.remarkable.desktop bundle.
The vendor’s public Mac download endpoint redirects to the Mac App Store instead of serving an inspectable disk image.

limitation: No accessible primary evidence established the Mach-O architecture of current Mac App Store version 3.29.0.
notes: The vendor's direct Mac-download endpoint now redirects to the Mac App Store.

name: ChemDraw
product: ChemDraw 20 for Mac by PerkinElmer Informatics, now Revvity Signals

evidence.says: Revvity removed ChemDraw 20.x installers from its download portal in March 2024 and ended support and updates for that series on September 30, 2026.
The original scan identifies the exact ChemDraw 20 bundle and reports x86 for version 20.1.0.112.
Revvity lists ARM and Intel Mac processor support as a new feature in the separately versioned ChemDraw 25.0 desktop line.

limitation: I found no definitive version number or executable for the final ChemDraw 20.x patch.
notes: The finding covers the supplied .20 bundle ID. The maintained ChemDraw Desktop product family added ARM releases in version 25.0.

name: Archetype Plini
product: Original Archetype: Plini standalone guitar amp app by Neural DSP

evidence.says: The vendor's Past Releases data lists 2.0.3 as the last original Archetype: Plini macOS installer and describes a delay synchronization fix.
Neural DSP explicitly identifies the original 2.0.2 standalone app as a universal Mac binary.
Neural DSP identifies Plini X as a later extension of the original product and offers it as a free update for existing users.

limitation: The last legacy installer is over the inspection limit, and I found explicit standalone architecture evidence for 2.0.2 only.
notes: The vendor still distributes the legacy installers under Past Releases. Plini X has its own standalone app.

name: Airmore Mindmap
product: AirMore Mind (爱莫脑图) desktop mind-mapping app by Apowersoft

evidence.says: Apowersoft identifies its 爱莫脑图 product and links the original desktop download.

Inspection of Airmore Mindmap.app/Contents/MacOS/Airmore Mindmap in the developer’s official download found x86_64 only, and its Info.plist identifies version 1.0.7 and bundle ID com.apowersoft.mindmap.
The original English-language AirMore Mind web entry point now redirects to GitMind.

limitation: Apple Silicon runtime under Rosetta was not established for AirMore Mind’s Mac build.
notes: The original download is still served; GitMind’s separate desktop installer does not establish this bundle’s architecture.
